section.title: Support matrix for automated &hanasr;
section.para: The support details are for high level overview only. Refer to the official documentation for the full conditions.
For help reading the support details, see .

table.title: Supported configurations for automated &hanasr; in HANA scale-up

row.entry: [A' => B] Secondary site is not read-only enabled, so does not accept client's inquiries.
HANA performance optimized, secondary site read-enabled
[A' => B”] Secondary site is read-enabled and can accept client's read-only inquiries.
[A' => B, Q”] topology is supported. Q is a QA instance running on the secondary site.
HANA multi-tier system replication (replication chain), third site NOT managed by &pace;
[A' => B] -> C topology is supported with conditions: A to B system replication in &pace; is supported. B to C system replication is not managed by &pace;.
HANA multi-target system replication, third site NOT managed by &pace;
[B <= A'] -> C topology is supported with conditions: A to B system replication in &pace; is supported. A to C system replication is not managed by &pace;.
HANA multi-SID performance optimized in one cluster (MCOS)
HANA performance optimized and &s4hana; &ensa2; in one cluster
HANA performance optimized cluster and stand-alone application server

table.title: Supported configurations for automated &hanasr; in HANA scale-out

row.entry: HANA performance optimized, up to 30 nodes including standby
Up to 30 HANA nodes including standby nodes.
HANA performance optimized, up to 12 nodes, no standby
Up to 12 HANA nodes, NO standby nodes.
HANA performance optimized, up to 4 nodes, secondary site read-enabled
Up to 4 HANA nodes, NO standby nodes.
HANA multi-target system replication, third site NOT managed by the cluster
[B <= A'] -> C topology is supported with conditions: Site A to site B system replication in &pace; is supported. Site A to site C system replication is not managed by &pace;.
HANA multi-tier system replication, third site NOT managed by the cluster
[A' => B] -> C topology is supported with conditions: A to B system replication in &pace; is supported. B to C system replication is not managed by &pace;.

Multi-tenancy is available for all the supported scenarios and use cases. This scenario is supported since &hana; 1.0 SPS12, and the default installation type for &hana; 2.0. The setup and configuration from a cluster point of view is the same for multi-tenancy and single containers because the tenants are managed all together by the &pace; cluster.
